title: Search across a handwritten notebook
description: Handwriting, diagrams and marks on documents are kept together. A word you find leads to a specific place on the page.

blocks.text: The owner of a handwritten notebook has a direct request: find a word among the pages without leafing through the whole archive. At the same time the drawings and the placement of the text stay part of the entry.

quote.text: One star on this app for not supporting the most basic feature I need for everyday productivity.  Please enable search on handwritten notes I take from iPad.

blocks.text: Search shows a thumbnail of the page and the place it found. The result of the recognition can be checked against the handwriting; the page itself is not replaced by automatically typed text.

Different handwriting and the user’s language both need testing. Uncertain recognition should not hide the original page. Diagrams, formulas and free-form marks may call for extra bookmarks instead of a promise to find everything.
